info.name: MassageReservation - Additional Requirements
info.description:
Single-file Postman Collection v2.1. Start the normal API with npm run dev, then run: npx newman run ./postman/MassageReservation.additional.json

Requirement mapping: AR01 create shop, AR02 edit shop, AR03 completed-booking ratings 1-5, AR04 optional real-email OTP reset, AR05 admin booking email (manual inbox check), AR06 welcome unique coupon (manual inbox/database check), AR07-10 special closing date CRUD.

Default run: automatic API checks; AR05/06 email assertions show SKIPPED, and the OTP success folder is not sent without explicit credentials/code. A green default run does not prove all 10 requirements.

To receive the first welcome email use --env-var customerEmail=YOUR_REAL_UNUSED_EMAIL. The collection creates that user, so choose a fresh demo address.

Request real OTP: npx newman run ./postman/MassageReservation.additional.json --folder "02 - Request password reset OTP" --env-var resetEmail=YOUR_EXISTING_EMAIL

Within 5 minutes, verify/reset: npx newman run ./postman/MassageReservation.additional.json --folder "03 - Verify OTP and reset password" --folder "04 - Final logout" --env-var resetEmail=YOUR_EXISTING_EMAIL --env-var resetPassword=YOUR_CURRENT_PASSWORD --env-var resetOtp=SIX_DIGITS

For a standalone reset run, final logout requests without tokens are skipped. resetNewPassword defaults to NewmanChanged123!; override it for your own demo account. Never use a real non-demo account.

Requires an existing admin and MongoDB replica set/Atlas. Override URL, adminEmail and adminPassword via --env-var. Tests create real users, shops, coupons and ratings and can send real emails. Bookings/closing dates are deleted on successful runs; other created records remain because the API has no delete endpoints for them. Logout invalidates existing sessions.

The collection-level 3-second assertion checks observed individual request latency, not load/performance guarantees. No helper JS files or test-only endpoints are required.

item.name: 01 - Additional API
item.description: Automatic API tests for AR01-03 and AR07-10 plus reset validation. AR05 and AR06 email checks are explicitly skipped until checked in a real mailbox.

exec: console.warn('AR05/AR06: check real admin/welcome emails separately; HTTP success does not verify inbox delivery. Use customerEmail with a real mailbox to receive the first welcome email.');

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Newman Additional {{runId}}",
  "address": "Newman demo address",
  "tel": "0898765432",
  "description": "Temporary additional requirements test shop",
  "openingTime": "09:00",
  "closingTime": "20:00"
}

exec: pm.test('Shop address updated', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.address).to.eql('Updated Newman demo address'); });

item.name: AR02 - Read back the edited shop

exec: pm.test('Shop changes are persisted', function () { const s=pm.response.json().data.find(s=>s._id===pm.collectionVariables.get('additionalShopId')); pm.expect(s.address).to.eql('Updated Newman demo address'); pm.expect(s.closingTime).to.eql('21:00'); });

item.name: AR06 - Register first user and trigger welcome coupon

exec: pm.test.skip('AR06 - Welcome email and unique coupon must be checked in the mailbox', function () {});

item.name: AR03 - Create another booking for five-star boundary
AR03 - Accept five stars after completion

exec: pm.test('Both boundary ratings are persisted for this shop', function () { const rows=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(rows).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(rows.map(r=>r.rating)).to.have.members([1,5]); rows.forEach(r=>pm.expect(r.shopId._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('additionalShopId'))); });

item.name: 02 - Request password reset OTP
item.description: Run separately with resetEmail set to an existing account with an accessible mailbox. If resetOtp is already supplied, no new OTP is requested.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('resetEmail') || !!pm.variables.get('resetOtp')) { console.warn("OTP request skipped: supply resetEmail without resetOtp to request a new code."); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('OTP is not exposed in the API response', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('otp'); });

item.name: 03 - Verify OTP and reset password
item.description: Opt in with resetEmail, resetPassword (current password), and resetOtp from the real email. This changes that account password to resetNewPassword.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('resetEmail') || !pm.variables.get('resetOtp') || !pm.variables.get('resetPassword')) { console.warn("OTP success flow skipped: resetEmail, resetPassword and a real resetOtp are required."); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

item.name: AR04 - Login reset account before changing its password

exec: pm.test('Save reset-account login token', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('resetLoginToken',b.token); });
pm.test('Wrong OTP rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid or expired OTP'); });
pm.test('Consumed OTP rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid or expired OTP'); });
pm.test('Password confirmation checked', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Passwords do not match'); });
pm.test('Password length checked', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Password must contain at least 6 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes'); });

item.name: AR04 - Pre-reset login token is invalidated
AR04 - Old password no longer works
AR04 - Reset token cannot be reused

exec: pm.test('Single-use reset token enforced', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid or expired reset token'); });

item.name: 04 - Final logout
item.description: Logout checks run last; admin logout is the final request. For a standalone OTP flow, select this folder as well.

item.name: Final - Second user token is rejected

exec: pm.test('Response time is below 3 seconds (single request)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(3000); });
